- YTXTube: the bottom tab is Downloads again (it had become Watch): the videos and music downloaded in YTXTube, the Pulse tab with the app's downloads, and Series and movies at the top
- Toolkit: a tool opens in the look's own dialog box (title, Close button, the page behind dimmed) instead of a loose panel; DNS and TTL has the apps list with a search box and a Wi-Fi / mobile data switch each (Access per app), the DNS host chips scroll (Quad9 no longer wraps), and a long tool scrolls instead of being cut
- DNS and TTL: an own Private DNS for Wi-Fi and for mobile data (setting, off): each network has its own mode (Keep, Auto, Off, Manual), host (Cloudflare, Google, AdGuard, Quad9 or your own) and a switch that makes a Manual one Auto while the network asks for a sign-in page; Wi-Fi starts as Auto, mobile data as Manual; it is written when the network changes (root or Shizuku once)
- Keyboard: Dictionary (meanings from Wiktionary and the Wikipedia summary of the selected word or the word before the cursor), Calculator and Convert tiles in the ⋮ menu (added once to the menu); the hybrid correction (WM Keyboard's engine beside Pulse's) is on by default
- DNS per network: a Manual DNS that makes the network lose its internet (eduroam and other networks that block the server) is put back to Auto by itself until the network changes; open Wi-Fi (no password) is Auto too
- Keyboard: a GIF button at the right of the emoji search box; Stickers (your own pictures from Download/Pulse/Stickers, a tap sends one) and Grammar (offline: spaces, repeated words, capitals, English apostrophes) tiles in the ⋮ menu
- PDF viewer: a finger on the empty sides of a page scrolls it too, a pinch grows the page around the fingers (not from the top left), and in landscape the top block is open at first
- Keyboard: a GIF page in the emoji panel (trending, three to a row, search above) and a small GIF mark on the emoji key (hold it for the GIFs); Ctrl and Win show icons (copy, paste, cut, lock ...) on the letters; the clipboard's item buttons use the keyboard's own line icons and the pin is a pin; the Passwords tile is in the ⋮ menu again
- Series and movies: when the engine cannot play a torrent the link goes to the other apps that take one
- YTXTube: the small window moves freely and elastically (springs to the nearest side), and the Downloads tab shows what is popular in series and films, a tap opens that title
- Toolkit: a QR reader (tile in the Toolkit and a Quick Settings tile): the camera is open at once, the code read is kept in a history, a link opens by itself (setting, on) and other text is shown with Copy and Share
- Poweramp widget: three layouts that follow the widget's shape (the standard window, a row for a wide short widget and a column for a tall or square one) instead of the standard window floating small in the middle; the touch areas follow each
- Crash fixed: 'Key "p0" was already used' in the Task Manager (several processes with an unknown pid shared one list key); the same guard in the process lists, the YTXTube music shelves and search history, the book list and the weather city lists
- Game Hub: a look setting (Settings > Look): the CD rack (jewel cases with the disc sliding out, three to a rail; the default) or Boxshelf's 3D shelf
- Openings: YTXTube opens with a play mark and a thin line in half a second; Pulse's own opening animation is about a third of its old length
- Keyboard: Ctrl + Shift + Esc opens the Task Manager; a corrected word is left alone after you undo its correction 2 times (1 or 2 in the settings; it was left alone after the first undo, so words typed wrong once stayed wrong)
- Keyboard: a "Tool icons" switch hides the tool-bar button and its icon row.
- Settings: the own-DNS-per-network switch is first in the DNS section.
- Keyboard: "Layout type" chips (QWERTY, Old phone T9, PC); phone keypad and the Old phone look have bigger keys.
- Floating keyboard: a resize grip at the right end of the handle makes it smaller or bigger (key height follows).
- Keyboard: the emoji board can have its own theme (Settings > Theme > Emoji board look); off ("Same") by default.
- Lyrics: stronger contrast between the line (and words) sung and the rest, a soft shadow, a darker backdrop; pulling down again at the first line closes the lyrics.
- Lyrics editor: on the Blended look the blurred cover shows behind it instead of black.
- Alarm: the forced full volume (awake check) rises step by step instead of jumping to the maximum.
- YTXTube: a taste engine on the phone (modelled on Flow's FlowNeuro, GPL-3.0): words of what is watched, searched and rejected, channel weights, five traits by time of day, with a "Your taste" page in Settings (persona, maturity, taste shape chart, interests, channels, hidden topics, pause and reset).
- YTXTube music: the home starts with Speed dial, Rediscover, Artists for you and Quick picks, made from what you play and ordered by your taste.
- YTXTube: playlist page in the Material layout (big cover, title, size and length, Play all / Shuffle pills, share, compact rows); channel page with a Home tab, Material tabs with a line and a new header (avatar, subscribe, name, stats); Subscriptions with "Quick access" and "Last refreshed".
- Music: bars and waves draw at the display rate, and stop while the app is in the background; hardware acceleration set for the whole app.
- Keyboard: pictures taken together (camera, screenshots, downloads of one kind) wait in the bar as a stack with a number; one tap sends them all. The look for new pictures is repeated every time the keyboard comes up (also back from the camera or the recent apps), with a quarter of an hour for camera photos.
- Floating keyboard: about 70 percent wide by default, as in the early versions.
- Keyboard: your own letter layouts (Settings > Languages > Letter layout): create with a live preview, edit, delete, share as a small text file, import a layout file. Standard stays the default.
- Lyrics: found lyrics are saved at once (by artist and title, also for streams) and never searched for again; the line in the media notification fills word by word as it is sung (word-synced lyrics).
- Lock screen lyrics: the lock screen's own camera shortcut no longer counts as "the camera opened", which closed the lyrics a moment after the screen woke.
- YTXTube: video cards and rows are plain taps (no spring, press tracking or animation per card): the feeds scroll lighter.
- YTXTube: channel avatars reach the feed in batches (the feed no longer redraws for every avatar found); the Liquid Glass switch is back in the settings (off by default).
- Music notification buttons: a long press on a row in the settings lifts it, and it is dragged to its place.
- Accessibility services marked "Not working" by Android are switched off and on again by Pulse (with root, Shizuku or the secure-settings grant), checked at every start and every 15 minutes; Pulse's services are on by default the first time that power is there. The auto clicker tile has a mouse cursor icon.
- Settings > Apps: the apps are tiles, three to a row (picture opens the app, a pill switches its home-screen icon, pin, and where it is listed).
